# Skye World MCP

Spatial world-site MCP by SkyesOverLondon.

React Three Fiber scene systems, Theatre.js director values, Remotion timed media, GSAP/Lenis scroll choreography, Motion pointer chrome, and a quality gate for immersive world pages.

## Connect

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "skye-world": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "skye-world-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `world_index` | Tool list and server metadata |
| `world_stack` | MCP2 world-site stack and runtime proof obligations |
| `world_rooms` | Five spatial chamber definitions |
| `world_scene` | React Three Fiber spatial scene recipe |
| `world_theatre` | Theatre.js director sheet recipe |
| `world_remotion` | Remotion Player world reel recipe |
| `world_spatial_nav` | Camera focus, drag plane, search, and minimap patterns |
| `world_motion_chrome` | GSAP ScrollTrigger, Lenis, and Motion pointer chrome |
| `world_css` | CSS tokens and key world-site classes |
| `world_quality_gate` | Audit source for required spatial runtime signals |

## Example Prompt

> Use `world_scene`, `world_theatre`, and `world_quality_gate` to build a spatial product page that behaves like a navigable world, not a stack of cards.
